Promotional drinkware, barware and gift programmes

Promotional products, barware and swag programmes run on the same production base: injection-moulded plastic and silicone drinkware with logo printing. That covers barware sets, brewery merchandise, onboarding and welcome kits, gift sets and white label ranges for resellers. Send the item list, quantity and artwork and we will confirm which items can share a mould and which need tooling.

Do you supply white label drinkware for resellers?

White label and private label packing are available for resellers. Send the item list and quantity and we confirm which items can share a mould.

Can you put together barware or welcome kit sets?

Barware sets, brewery merchandise and onboarding kits are assembled from the same production base. Send the item list and we confirm what can be kitted together.

CUSTOMIZATION, BUILT AROUND YOUR BRIEF

More than a logo on a cup.

Match the decoration and components to the material, surface, use and budget.

Screen & UV printing

Silkscreen, pad print or full-wrap UV on a straight or tapered wall. A digital proof on your actual model comes back before anything is printed.

From 10 pcs · proof in 1–2 days

Laser decoration

A permanent mark cut into the surface, no ink to wear off. Best on solid hard plastic; not on soft silicone, and not across a seam.

Tritan and hard plastic

LED configuration

Base-lit, water-activated or switch. The module is chosen for the cup you pick, and we film the light before the run starts.

CR2032 or sealed module

Material & color

Silicone, Tritan, PP and AS — matched to your Pantone number, not to a photograph of a swatch book.

Pantone matching

Artwork & decoration

Heat transfer, water transfer, in-mould labels and pad print. We tell you which one actually holds on your shape.

Vector file preferred

Custom packaging

Gift box, kraft sleeve, printed insert, barcode and marketplace-ready labelling. Packed to arrive intact, not to look good in a photo.

02STEP 02 · HOW IT RUNS

FROM BRIEF TO DELIVERY

A clear path to your custom order.

01

Share your brief

Product or idea, quantity, artwork and destination.

02

Review & quote

Agree materials, customization and any tooling.

03

Approve a sample

Approve the specification, artwork and sample.

04

Produce & inspect

Follow the agreed acceptance and packing requirements.

05

Arrange delivery

Confirm shipping scope, destination and arrival plan.

03STEP 03 · HOW LONG

HOW LONG IT ACTUALLY TAKES

Four clocks, not one.

A single lead-time number hides where the wait sits. Here are the four stages separately, so your arrival date is built from parts you can check.

  • 01Samplingusually 3–5 days after drawing approvalSamples are usually completed 3–5 days after drawing approval. Confirm the selected model, colours, structure and set composition before sampling.
  • 02New tooling30–40 daysEnd to end, from cutting steel to your approval on the first sample. Machining one version of the mould is about 3–4 weeks of that; the rest is scheduling and trial shots.
  • 03Production25–30 daysA standard run after the sample is signed. Colour matching, special inks, multi-part sets and a first batch off a brand-new mould all add time on top.
  • 04Transit7–10 daysDoor to door, counted from the day the goods leave us. Production is not included in this number.

Stack the stages you actually need. A repeat order on an existing model is production plus transit. A new product is tooling, then production, then transit.

04STEP 04 · WHERE IT CAN STOP

QUALITY CONTROL

Four points where a batch can be stopped.

  1. Incoming materialResin and silicone checked against the grade named on the spec sheet before it reaches a machine.
  2. First-off sampleThe first parts off the mould are measured against the approved sample. Nothing runs on until they match.
  3. In-processWall thickness, colour and print position are checked through the run, not only at the end.
  4. Final inspectionAppearance and packing checked against the acceptance points agreed on your order.

PAPER YOU CAN CHECK

Six documents, scanned.

A certificate proves a system exists. A test report proves a batch was checked. Both are on this site, unedited, at the size they were issued.

BEFORE YOU REQUEST A QUOTE

Start with what you know.

Can I start with 10 pieces?

Small-batch customization starts from 10 pieces on eligible configurations. Share the model, number of designs and packaging requirements; custom tooling and special specifications are reviewed separately.

Does one-day sampling apply to a new mold?

Sampling can be as fast as one day for eligible projects. New molds, new structures and complex decoration require a separate assessment. Confirm sample type, artwork approval and timing in the quote.

What does 7–10 day door-to-door delivery include?

The 7–10 days is transit only, counted from the day your goods are packed and handed to the carrier. Production is not included: a standard run takes 25–30 days ex-works, and new tooling takes 30–40 days end to end. Plan production and shipping as two separate blocks when you set a launch date.

Can I enquire without a model or drawing?

Yes. Describe the intended use, approximate quantity and required arrival date. You can add a reference image or artwork on the existing enquiry form.

03第 3 步 · 要多久

周期到底怎么算

不是一个数，是四个。

一个总周期数字说不清时间花在哪。拆成四段摆出来，你的到货日期是按能核对的每一段加起来的。

  • 01打样通常在图纸确认后3–5天制作完成样品通常在图纸确认后3–5天制作完成。打样前确认型号、配色、结构和套装组成。
  • 02新开模30–40 天从开钢料到你在首样上签字，整段 30–40 天。其中加工一套模具约 3–4 周，剩下是排产和试模。
  • 03大货生产25–30 天样品签完后跑常规大货的时间。配色、特殊油墨、多件套、以及从全新模具下来的第一批，都要在这个基础上加。
  • 04运输7–10 天门到门，从货离开我们那天起算。这个数字不含生产。

按你实际要走的段加：现有款返单＝大货＋运输；新产品＝开模＋大货＋运输。

04第 4 步 · 哪里会停

质量控制

四个可以把一批货拦下来的节点。

  1. 来料树脂和硅胶先核对规格书上写明的牌号，再上机。
  2. 首件开模后的头几件拿去量，和签样对上才继续跑。
  3. 过程中壁厚、颜色、印刷位置在跑的过程中抽，不是等做完才看。
  4. 出货前外观和包装按订单上约定的验收要点核对。

体系证书证明有一套流程在跑，检测报告证明某一批被检过。两种都在站上，按原样摆出来。

询价前常见问题

从已知需求开始即可。

可以从 10 件开始吗？

适用配置可从 10 件小批量定制开始。请提供型号、设计数量和包装需求；新开模及特殊规格单独评估。

新开模项目的样品时间如何确认？

样品通常在图纸确认后3–5天制作完成。新开模项目的模具环节及整体排期另行确认。

7–10 天门到门包含哪些环节？

7–10 天只算运输段——从货打包完成交到承运人那天起算，不含生产。常规大货出厂约 25–30 天，新开模整段 30–40 天。排上市时间时，生产和运输分两段算。

没有型号或图纸也能询价吗？

可以。说明用途、预计数量及期望到货日期即可，也可在现有询价表单中添加参考图片或图稿。
